verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both keep the brand colours, fonts and the headline > subline > CTA order. Both share the same flaws: the headline breaks into five ragged lines with "little" alone on its own line, and "botanicals" nearly touches both side edges. The large empty gaps between the headline, the "Now in four flavours" line and the CTA push the CTA low, so the three pieces no longer read as one group.
